In detail

The far west — Pegli with its villas and seafront, then Prà and Voltri. The Municipio's own representatives went public in May 2026 describing crime on their territory as in constant growth and asking for permanent instruments rather than occasional operations, and piazza Rapisardi appears in the 2026 plan's priority list. Quiet seaside suburb by day, a long way from the centre.
